title: GitHub main-branch protection application package

plan.objective: Convert the reviewed branch-protection recommendation into an exact repository-admin settings package.
steps: Create or update the main-branch ruleset.
Require Production OS CI before merge.
Require one approving review and resolved conversations.
Dismiss stale approvals after new commits.
Block force pushes, branch deletion, and direct bypass except named emergency administrators.
Verify the resulting ruleset and branch-protection read endpoints.

findings.message: GitHub currently reports main as unprotected and required checks as procedurally enforced only.
The exact required checks and review controls are fully specified for repository administration.

next_gate: Apply the ruleset through GitHub repository administration and verify the branch-protection state.
